name: Stock Risk Scanner
blurb: ranks single-source and low-stock parts in a BOM by risk
intro: Paste a BOM with stock, sources, lead time and lifecycle columns (e.g. from a distributor or Octopart export). Each part gets a 0–100 risk score from a stated rule of thumb: lifecycle, number of manufacturers, stock against what this build needs, and lead time. Parts are ranked worst first.

usage: Give the BOM as CSV/TSV text with a header row: MPN and Qty per board plus any of Stock, Sources (count) or Alternates (MPN list), Lead time (weeks or days) and Lifecycle; give the number of boards and the comfortable stock multiple. It returns every part ranked by a 0–100 score with level (High/Medium/Low), need vs stock, coverage and the reasons, plus counts of high-risk, single-source and short parts. Use it before a production buy or when choosing where to add second sources.
sources: Rule of thumb: scoring weights are this tool's own, modelled on common supply-risk checks (lifecycle per IEC 62402 obsolescence management, single-source and stock coverage as in distributor BOM tools)
